desc: Scaled up for those who want more, the Bel Air XL offers the same streamlined style as the original, only bigger and just as tough. The DuraLock mechanism ensures smooth, secure blade action, and a reversible deep-carry clip keeps it low-profile in the pocket. For a USA-made folder with size, strength, and cutting power, without sacrificing everyday carry comfort, the Bel Air XL delivers it all.
